verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a developer API, OpenAPI spec, and an official CLI (ramp-cli), which could technically enable bulk operations like batch approvals or exports, but no evidence explicitly documents a bulk-operations feature or workflow for handling many items at once. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk approve/reject/export/categorize actions, any bulk-endpoint or batch API examples, and user/community confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
